candidates.name: compass-history::PartitionedGraph
candidates.notes: Record-class partitioning already implemented and tested in-repo for historical realizations; unused by the current-graph publication path. Partitions by record class, not graph topology, so no edge-cut problem. Adoption blocked on an ownership decision (compass-history vs compass-graph).

evidence.claim: PartitionedGraph splits nodes/edges/hyperedges/analysis/metadata/program_facts/program_summaries into individually keyed records
partition(), into_partition(), and reconstruct() exist and round-trip
No usage outside compass-history; current-graph path does not use it

candidates.name: Distributed graph sharding (multi-store)
candidates.notes: Solves multi-machine scaling. Compass is local-first single-process; sharding would add distributed-query cost and eventual consistency, violating the determinism invariant.

evidence.claim: Sharding targets scaling past the limits of any one machine; partitioning lowers cost under a fixed ceiling and is nearly free operationally
Apply only when total data volume exceeds single-instance capacity and vertical scaling cannot address it
Graph sharding yields multiple differently-sharded copies and typically eventual consistency
Graph interconnectivity makes topological partitioning hard, especially for high-degree nodes

candidates.name: Streaming chunk reader for load_active_snapshot
candidates.notes: No external library needed. The write path already streams via DigestWriter; the read path does not. Making the read path stream removes the real memory constraint and makes the crate's own doc comment true. Prerequisite for G1.

evidence.claim: load_active_snapshot pre-allocates payload_bytes and concatenates all chunks into one contiguous Vec<u8>
Doc comment claims records are served through indexed scans instead of materializing the whole document
DigestWriter implements io::Write and hashes incrementally; the write path never materializes the payload

build_required.description: Stream load_active_snapshot so reconstruction never materializes the full document
Make the snapshot limit error actionable (name override, --exclude, .compassignore, dominant content class)
Pre-flight graph size estimate so oversized builds fail before full extraction
Honor COMPASS_MAX_GRAPH_BYTES on the publication path — ONLY after A
